welcome.body: Three quick steps: about you, your body scan and a short health check. It takes about two minutes.
welcome.noticeBody: Rafiq gives general fitness and nutrition guidance. It is not medical advice and does not replace a doctor, dietitian or physiotherapist. Stop and get help if you feel pain, dizziness or chest discomfort.
